programme.title: Exploring Korean Literature
programme.desc: 2021 Exploring Korean Literature There is a growing interest in Korean literature among readers from around the world and so we bring Korean classics to Korean modern literature to viewers in this special series under three themes. What They’ve Read Well-known TV personalities read three translated works of Korean literature that have recently received attention. Kim Soom's novel "One Left", brings the comfort women issue to the forefront of the literary world, and her book is recited and discussed by Darcy Paquet, a translator and essayist for the film "Parasite," and translator and essayist Colin Marshall, Italian architect Simone Carena, and fashion designer Shin Ji-hye. The novel was published in the U.S. in September 2020 and a second book print was released this year. Cho Nam-Joo's novel "Kim Jiyoung, Born 1982" has been translated into 25 languages and is recited by TV personality Daniel Hicks (UK), Carlos Gorito (Brazil), YouTuber Sarah Mack (USA) and singer Punita (India) who share their thoughts about the book. Howon, a member of the boy band, W24, recites passages from Kim Young-ha's novel "Diary of a Murderer" and gives commentary. Living to Tell a Story This documentary features Korean writers whose works are not only popular in Korea but also overseas. In episode 1, poet Kim Yi-deum, the Winner of the National Translation Award and the Lucien Stryk Award for her collection of poems, "Hysteria," as well as Korean novelists Kim Cho-Yup and Kim Yeon-su appear to talk about the creative process and how they carry out research before writing a novel. In Episode 2, novelist Yun Ko-Eun, the winner of the Crime Fiction in Translation Dagger award for her book, "The Disaster Tourist", and novelist Ha Seong-nan and poet Jin Eun-young explain what they were trying to convey to readers through their works. In Episode 3, novelist Hwang Sok-young, whose works are mostly inspired by his own experience of living in modern Korean society, tells the story of his life and literary journey. A Word Depicted in Stories The cultural characteristics in Korean literature that encompasses Korean classics to modern novels are highlighted on this show. Six episodes with different themes ranging from female poets in classical literature, makeup culture, wine and arts, tea ceremony, pets, and a literary discussion forum will begin airing on November 5th. -->

programme.title: K-CHAT: Travel in Korea
programme.desc: Simple and Fun Korean Lessons, “K-Chat: Travel in Korea” What are the most useful expressions visitors to Korea can use right away?From arriving at the airport to finding your hotel and exploring popular travel destinations, this program offers practical expressions for your Korean language journey. It also covers traditional Korean culture and essential travel information, making it an invaluable resource for beginner to intermediate learners! Discover Korean travel expressions in an engaging and entertaining way with skits performed by ONF’s Hyo-jin, Seung-jun, Wyatt, and Alexa. With clear and accessible explanations from Hye-rim of the Wonder Girls, a graduate of Hankuk University of Foreign Studies, you’ll systematically improve your Korean!

programme.title: Diplomat's Archives: Hidden Stories
programme.desc: As of April 2025, S. Korea has established diplomatic relations with a total of 194 countries. Among them are countries that have had ties and exchanges with Korea for hundreds of years. With such long-standing relationships with so many nations, might there be fascinating hidden stories between Korea and the rest of the world that we don’t know yet? "Diplomat’s Archives: Hidden Stories" begins with this very question. Together with foreign embassies in Korea, the series uncovers and sheds light on meaningful yet lesser-known stories between Korea and other countries. Through this, we aim to reaffirm the deep friendships that have been built over time, highlight how countries are interconnected—bilaterally and multilaterally— and emphasize the importance of cooperation on the global stage today.

programme.title: Beauty On and Off
programme.desc: K-Beauty is loved all around the world, but choosing the “right” product isn’t always easy. With so many reviews out there, it can sometimes feel even more confusing. So two male idols hit the streets themselves! Still new to the world of beauty, they meet everyday Koreans— people who are true “beauty experts” in their daily lives, each with their own routines and must-have products. Inspired by the recommendations they hear on the street, the two idols try the products themselves, sharing honest reviews and comparing their different tastes as they discover what works best for them. Step by step, their experiences and notes come together, eventually forming their very own special “beauty book”. Join two idols on their honest and fun journey as they explore and discover the world of K-Beauty together!

programme.title: AI Decoded
programme.desc: The AI industry has just had the fright of its life. After a shock US midterm election result handed Democrats control of both houses of Congress, the companies leading the AI revolution suddenly face an uncomfortable reality: investigations, subpoenas, public backlash and the prospect of sweeping new regulation. At the very centre of the storm is Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, whose company sits at the heart of the global AI boom. Recent revelations surrounding Huang have triggered a crisis of confidence, wiped hundreds of billions from Nvidia's market value, and raised difficult questions about corporate governance, national security and the concentration of power inside the AI industry. Meanwhile, Elon Musk's political gamble appears to have backfired spectacularly. After pouring hundreds of millions of dollars into the midterms, Silicon Valley's most influential figures are now confronting a Congress that may be far less willing to give them the benefit of the doubt.

programme.title: Global Eye
programme.desc: A weekly programme from the BBC World Service, bringing forensic journalism from all corners of the world by BBC Eye, the World Service's critically acclaimed investigative unit, and featuring expert global correspondents getting to the heart of the biggest international stories. In this episode: Akisa Wandera reports from Angola, where billions of dollars are being poured into a vast new trade corridor at the centre of a global race for critical minerals. We examine what's at stake for the people living on the frontline of this transformation. Plus: BBC Brasil travels to the city of Camaçari, where Chinese carmaker BYD has opened its biggest factory in Latin America. As Chinese investment reshapes jobs, industry and daily life, we explore how one Brazilian city has become a test case for the growing rivalry between China and the United States.

programme.desc: It's been a week of great consequence for the media. On Monday, Russell Brand was sentenced to over ten years in prison for rape and sexual assault. programme.title: The Interface
programme.desc: A wave of fridge and freezer hacks in Europe could be a sign of something much bigger. Thomas Germain and Jessica Maddox ask whether we're heading for a 'hackpocalypse', a world where AI helps almost anyone find and exploit old security flaws. Plus, Google says that US schools can now switch off AI on student Chromebooks, but if they do, kids will lose access to Google Search. Google says the two are now too closely linked to separate - and the changes give schools more choice. Tom and Jess dig into why it's a controversial move, what it says about Google's grip on American schools, and what it could mean for Big Tech at a time when the public is losing patience with AI.

programme.sub-title: Black Ink Crew I Did Not Sleep With That Women!
programme.desc: When Dutchess and Ceaser are hours late for a photo shoot at the shop, the editor of the magazine rips them a new one. When Ceaser confronts Walt about his drinking, Walt reveals some shocking news that will change his future. Presented by VH1.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: O'S**t reaches new "baby mama" heights when he reveals that he has yet another child on the way. Dutchess shows up at a meeting and sees an ex-boyfriend. When Ceaser finds out, he loses his cool and deserts her at his family BBQ. Presented by VH1.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.sub-title: Black Ink Crew Have Several Seats
programme.desc: In the wake of Dutchess and Ceaser's fight, Ceaser is left confused about their future together and escapes to Puma's bachelor party in Atlantic City. Kathy comes for a tattoo from O'S**t, to get some closure and move on with her life. Presented by VH1.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.sub-title: Black Ink Crew You Got Some Stupid Ears
programme.desc: Puma decides to invite Ceaser to his wedding on the condition that he leaves Dutchess at home. Walt's frustrating search comes to an end when a letter arrives at the shop with information about his father. Presented by VH1.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew Chicago
programme.desc: Charmaine takes the 9MAG crew to Vegas for a tattoo convention in an attempt to prove her worth to Ryan. When Van's apprentice shows up, everyone speculates on where she's going to be sleeping at night. Meanwhile, Don focuses on his family back home.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew Chicago
programme.desc: Junior arrives in Las Vegas to take the guys out for a spin on the Strip, and Shine contemplates giving up his guest artist spot at 9MAG. Things get awkward for everyone when Van and Jenn decide to head to the altar.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew Chicago
programme.desc: After Jenn and Van's Vegas chapel disaster, Charmaine tries to get the trip back on track with one last Vegas 9MAG pool party. Jenn and Van hash it out and Lily finally confronts Junior and Adriana. Phor spirals into a dark place.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew Chicago
programme.desc: Junior is officially back at 9MAG and Charmaine hooks Ryan up with a celebrity client, Erica Mena. Bella reconnects with an old flame, and the gang gets together for a 9MAG Friendsgiving.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew Chicago
programme.sub-title: I Didn't Say I Hate Her (I Just Don't Like Her)
programme.desc: All of 9MAG reacts to what happened on Friendsgiving. Junior gets in touch with himself and his past, Don expands his horizons and Charmaine outs Lily as a racist.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew Chicago
programme.sub-title: I Hope You Make it to America
programme.desc: Ryan gets an ominous call for a meeting from the building management to discuss the future of 9MAG, Lily uses her break from the shop to focus on her art, Charmaine decides to organize a protest and Van does whatever it takes to win Jenn back.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.sub-title: Black Ink Crew Tell the Truth and Shame the Devil
programme.desc: O'S**t's baby mamas, Coley and Kathy, face each other for the first time since their violent "family meal." Ceaser is torn between his friends and his woman as Dutchess reacts negatively to not being invited to Puma's wedding. Presented by VH1.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: When O'S**t reappears at the shop, Walt tears into him about friendship and responsibility. After fighting in Jamaica together, Dutchess runs from the resort and, unbeknownst to Ceaser, ends up collapsing in the parking lot. Presented by VH1.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.sub-title: Black Ink Crew From Wedlock to Headlock
programme.desc: The crew are having the time of their lives in Jamaica but are shocked when Ceaser suddenly sends Dutchess packing! At the wedding, the crew is left wondering if this Black Ink love story will have an unhappy ending. Presented by VH1.

programme.title: Cheers: Keine Liebe, keine Werbung
programme.desc: Eine attraktive Werbefrau in mittleren Jahren verspricht Sam lukrative Fernsehspots. Das Angebot gilt nur, wenn er sich auch sonst ihr gegenüber nicht abweisend zeigt. Sam geht auf ihre Forderungen ein.

programme.title: Cheers: Geteilter Kummer
programme.desc: Diane bekommt einen Anruf von ihren Eltern. Sie muss voller Schmerz erfahren, dass ihre Katze gestorben ist. Sie erzählt allen von dem Unglück. Aber weder die Stammgäste noch ihre Kollegen wollen den Kummer mit ihr teilen.

programme.title: Cheers: Männer sind doch alle Schrott...
programme.desc: Carla ist schwanger. Die Überraschung im Cheers ist groß. Carlas Kollegen sind völlig aus dem Häuschen, als sie erfahren, wer der Vater ist: ein unscheinbarer Gelehrtentyp.

programme.title: Cheers: Unsere Bar soll sauber bleiben!
programme.desc: Die Stammbesetzung im Cheers hegt Befürchtungen, die Bar könnte zu einem Schwulentreff werden. Sofort beginnt ein hässliches Gestichel gegen Gäste, die man für homosexuell hält.

programme.title: Cheers: Das ideale Rendezvous
programme.desc: Sam und Diane denken sich ein Spielchen aus: Jeder soll dem anderen den idealen Partner zum Rendezvous herbeischaffen. Diane nimmt die Abmachung ernst und besorgt eine herbe Schönheit.

programme.title: Cheers: Bostons beste Bedienung
programme.desc: Der alljährliche Kellnerinnen-Wettbewerb der Stadt findet dieses Jahr im Cheers statt. Sam hat Diane dafür angemeldet – allerdings ohne ihr Wissen.

programme.title: Cheers: Der betrogene Betrüger
programme.desc: Der allzu vertrauensselige Coach hat 8.000 Dollar an einen Berufsspieler verloren. Sam und seine Stammbesetzung im Cheers lassen sich etwas einfallen. Sie wollen den Betrüger aufs Kreuz legen.

programme.title: Cheers: Trauung am Tresen
programme.desc: Dianes Mutter kommt zu Besuch. Der Grund: Es gibt eine Klausel im Testament ihres verstorbenen Gatten. Die besagt, dass Tochter Diane umgehend verheiratet werden muss. Als Zukünftiger bietet sich Sam an.

programme.title: Cheers: Ein Halbgott als Bruder
programme.desc: Sams Bruder Derek kommt auf Besuch ins Cheers. Er ist derjenige von beiden, der immer alles besser konnte. Folgerichtig hat er auch Diane sofort um den Finger gewickelt.

programme.title: Cheers: Hau ab und bleib hier!
programme.desc: Es scheint, als hätte Sam seine Chancen bei Diane verspielt. Sie hat sich offenbar für seinen Bruder Derek entschieden. Bevor sie ganz zu ihm geht, sucht sie eine letzte Auseinandersetzung mit Sam.

programme.title: Cheers: Deine Wohnung, meine Wohnung?
programme.desc: Diane und Sam streiten sich heftig. Das erregt sie so, dass sie sich im Bett versöhnen wollen. Sie fahren zu Dianes Wohnung, wo der Streit erneut losbricht. Sam hat etwas gegen Dianes Kuscheltiere einzuwenden. Diane schmeißt ihn kurzerhand aus der Wohnung

programme.title: Cheers: Das wilde Mauerblümchen
programme.desc: Carla erwartet ein Baby. Deshalb soll ihre Schwester Annette im Cheers aushelfen. Sie ist alles andere als ein schüchternes Mauerblümchen.

programme.title: Cheers: Geschäftliche Beziehungen
programme.desc: Norm trennt sich von seiner Frau Vera. Er leidet schwer darunter. Diane trennt sich währenddessen vom Cheers. Nach zwei Wochen findet sie einen neuen Job. Leider muss sie feststellen, dass ihr neuer Chef mehr an ihr als an ihrer Arbeit interessiert ist.

programme.title: Cheers: Der Kneipen-Othello
programme.desc: Diane spielt im Cheers Szenen aus Shakespeares ,,Othello". Die Hauptrolle wird von einem Ex-Häftling übernommen. Für sie als Desdemona wird das Ganze lebensgefährlich.

programme.title: Cheers: Krieg und Frieden
programme.desc: Diane will, dass Sam zu einem Abendessen mit ihrem Ex-Verlobten mitkommt. Bei dem Verflossenen handelt es sich um einen Literaturprofessor. Sam versucht, seine Bildungslücken durch die Lektüre von Tolstojs ,,Krieg und Frieden" wettzumachen.

programme.title: Cheers: Eine Herzenssache
programme.desc: Carla hat unter den Gästen im Cheers einen neuen Verehrer namens Hank. Sam und Diane müssen etwas nachhelfen, bevor es zum ersten Rendezvous kommt.

programme.title: Cheers: Die 24-Stunden-Versuchung
programme.desc: Ein alter Freund von Sam hat sich ein Ziel gesetzt: Innerhalb von 24 Stunden will er Sam und Diane auseinander bringen. Dazu schickt er die hübsche Deedee vor, die den Frauenhelden Sam betören soll.

programme.title: Cheers: Der Tyrann am Spielfeldrand
programme.desc: Coach will es noch einmal wissen: Er beginnt, eine Nachwuchs-Baseballmannschaft zu trainieren. Prompt entwickelt er sich zum Tyrannen am Spielfeldrand.

programme.title: Cheers: Kampf der Giganten
programme.desc: Norm hat sich von Vera getrennt. Nun trauert er seiner Frau hinterher. Als er erfährt, dass ein alter Schulfreund sein Glück bei Vera versucht, fordert er ihn zum Zweikampf heraus.

programme.title: Cheers: Was sag' ich meiner Liebsten?
programme.desc: Sam bekommt von Diane zwei Karten für einen Boxkampf geschenkt. Vor lauter Freude sagt er zu ihr ‚Ich liebe dich‘. Diane ist sehr glücklich darüber, doch dann stellt sich heraus, dass dieser Satz für Sam nur eine Floskel ist.

programme.title: Cheers: Die Freundinnen meiner Freundin
programme.desc: Dianes beste Freundin Heather taucht im Cheers auf. Sam ist von der attraktiven Frau mehr als beeindruckt. Diane platzt fast vor Eifersucht und tut ihr Möglichstes, damit die zwei sich nicht zu nahe kommen.

programme.title: Cheers: Kramers letzter Wille
programme.desc: Mr. Malcolm Kramer hat nur noch ein halbes Jahr zu leben. Mike lässt den Mann als Barkeeper arbeiten. Der fühlt sich so wohl im Cheers, dass er den Stammgästen 100.000 Dollar vermachen will. Daraufhin bricht Chaos aus.

programme.title: Cheers: Der Mitleidskuß
programme.desc: Sam tut Carla einen Riesengefallen: Deren Ex-Mann Nick, das Ekel, heiratet wieder. Er hat Carla zur Hochzeit eingeladen. Sam geht mit – und spielt Carlas feurigen Liebhaber.

programme.title: Cheers: Vom Tellerwäscher zum Buchhalter

programme.title: Revenant Zmrtvýchvstání
programme.desc: Velkolepý snímek REVENANT Zmrtvýchvstání vzdává hold neobyčejné síle lidského ducha a nabízí strhující divácký zážitek. Legendární lovec a dobrodruh Hugh Glass (Leonardo DiCaprio) je během výpravy v americké divočině brutálně napaden medvědem a zanechán napospas smrti zbylými členy své lovecké skupiny. V neúnavné snaze přežít a najít vykoupení Glass přetrpí nepředstavitelný smutek, stejně jako zradu od svého souputníka Johna Fitzgeralda (Tom Hardy). Jedinou zbraní mu je nezlomná vůle a láska k rodině, díky níž se Glass pouští do boje s krutou zimou v zatím nezmapované krajině. Tento film, inspirovaný skutečným příběhem, získal tři Oscary: za nejlepší režii, kameru a pro herce v hlavní roli Leonarda DiCapria.

programme.title: Zelená kniha
programme.desc: Snímek Zelená kniha, který se odehrává v Americe roku 1962, vypráví srdceryvný skutečný příběh Tonyho "Pyska", amerického vyhazovače italského původu, který začne pracovat jako řidič dr. Dona Shirleyho, slavného a vzdělaného černošského klavíristy. Nesourodá dvojice se vydá na dvouměsíční turné po rasismem prostoupeném jihu Spojených států. Aby společně překonali nástrahy, musí si k sobě oba tvrdohlaví muži najít cestu skrz předsudky a humorné přešlapy.

programme.title: Ricky Bobby: Nejrychlejší jezdec
programme.desc: Americká akční komedie režiséra Adama McKaye nás zavádí do světa profesionálních závodů sériových automobilů. Jejich senzací a národním hrdinou je Ricky Bobby (Will Ferrell), který vyhrává za každou cenu. On a jeho věrný parťák, kamarád od dětství Cal Naughton ml. (John C. Reilly), jsou vskutku nebojácná dvojka - fanoušci jim přezdívají "Hrom" a "Blesk", protože většinu závodů dojedou na prvním a druhém místě. Ten druhý ovšem bývá Cal. Jenže když je namyšlený jezdec francouzské formule 1 Jean Girard (Sacha Baron Cohen) vyzve k souboji o prvenství, Bobby musí nejen čelit svým běsům, ale hlavně si vybojovat právo stát na čele závodnické špičky.

programme.title: Šifra mistra Leonarda
programme.desc: Světový bestseller Dana Browna s názvem Šifra mistra Leonarda přichází ve filmové podobě režiséra Rona Howarda. Symbololog Robert Langdon (Tom Hanks) je zapleten do záhadné a bizarní vraždy. Po svém boku má vnučku oběti a kryptoložku Sophii Neveuovou (Audrey Tautouová), která společně s Robertem objeví stopy obsažené v Da Vinciho obrazech. Ve snaze rozklíčovat celou pravdu se Robert se Sophií vydají z Paříže do Londýna a cestou potkají nejen spojence, ale i darebáky jako jsou Sir Leigh Teabing (Ian McKellen) a Silas (Paul Bettany). Ať už je kroky zavedou kamkoli, tajemství, které má vyplout na povrch, by mohlo otřást základy křesťanství.

programme.title: Zkus mě rozesmát
programme.desc: Danny (Adam Sandler) je úspěšný plastický chirurg, který má opravdu nekonvenční sváděcí taktiky: předstírá, že je nešťastně ženatý. Když však potká ženu svých snů (Brooklyn Decker) svůj osvědčený příběh o nevydařeném manželství nechá u ledu a raději je sám sebou. Jenže jeho vyvolená brzy objeví jeho falešný snubní prstýnek. Danny se bojí jí říci trapnou pravdu, a tak své drahé raději namluví, že se rozvádí. Jenže ta se chce s jeho ženou setkat. A tak Dannymu nezbývá nic jiného, než požádat svou asistentku Katherine (Jennifer Aniston) o pomoc. Jenže jedna lež vede ke druhé, celá situace se pěkně zamotá a nakonec vše skončí výletem na Havaj, který jim zcela změní život.

programme.title: Ave, Caesar!
programme.desc: Oscaroví filmoví tvůrci Joel a Ethan Coenovi (Tahle země není pro starý, Opravdová kuráž, Fargo) napsali a natočili film AVE, CAESAR!. Příběh nás zavede na natáčení typického hollywoodského velkofilmu z padesátých let minulého století Ave Caesar!. Šéf studia Eddie Mannix (Josh Brolin) investoval astronomické částky do výpravy, kulis a herců, ale superhvězda Baird Whitlock (George Clooney) byla během natáčení unesena.

programme.title: Hon na lišku
programme.desc: Snímek FOXCATCHER, inspirovaný skutečnými událostmi, vypráví příběh olympijského vítěze v zápase Marka Schultze (Channing Tatum). Ten spatří příležitost vykročit ze stínu svého slavného staršího bratra Davea (Mark Ruffalo) a života v chudobě poté, co se mu dostane pozvání od bohatého dědice Johna du Ponta (Steve Carell), aby se nastěhoval do jeho okázalého sídla, kde má sestavit a trénovat zápasnický tým pro olympiádu v Soulu v roce 1988. Du Pont, jenž se zoufale snaží získat respekt své odmítavé matky (Vanessa Redgraveová), se staví do pozice hlavního trenéra celého týmu. Du Pontova nevypočitatelná povaha a psychologické hrátky ale začínají velmi výrazně nahlodávat Markovo již tak nejisté sebevědomí a negativně ovlivňovat výkony, které je schopen na žíněnce podávat. Když začne du Pont upřednostňovat jeho bratra Davea - který má autoritu i sebevědomí, jež Mark i du Pont postrádají - je celé trio na cestě vstříc tragédii, kterou nikdo nedokázal předvídat.

programme.title: Steve Jobs
programme.desc: Snímek "Steve Jobs" se odehrává na pozadí uvedení tří legendárních produktů na trh a končí v roce 1998, kdy byl představen počítač iMac. Zavádí nás do zákulisí digitální revoluce a vykresluje intimní portrét geniálního muže, který stál v jejím středu. Režisérem filmu je oscarový Danny Boyle a scénář napsal držitel Oscara Aaron Sorkin na základě bestsellerového životopisu zakladatele společnosti Apple od Waltera Isaacsona. Michael Fassbender hraje Steva Jobse, průkopnického zakladatele společnosti Apple, a v hlavní roli Joanny Hoffmanové, bývalé marketingové šéfky společnosti Macintosh, se představuje držitelka Oscara® Kate Winsletová. Spoluzakladatele společnosti Apple Steva Wozniaka hraje Seth Rogen a Jeff Daniels vystupuje jako bývalý generální ředitel Applu John Sculley.

programme.title: Rocky III
programme.desc: V energickém akčním filmu se Rocky utkává se svým dosud nejsilnějším protivníkem - krutým svalovcem jménem Clubber Lang (Mr. T). V možná nejnapínavějším a nejpoutavějším dílu celé série jde Rocky od jednoho vítězství ke druhému, podepisuje lukrativní smlouvy a stává se slavným po celém světě. Když ale "italský hřebec" utrpí potupnou porážku od Clubbera Langa, zdá se, že pomalu ztrácí své výsadní postavení. S pomocí odvěkého rivala Apolla Creeda (Carl Weathers) se Rocky snaží znovu získat bojového ducha, aby se s Langem mohl utkat ve vyčerpávající odvetě o světového šampiona v těžké váze.

programme.title: Good bye, Lenin!
programme.desc: Říjen roku 1989 nebyl právě nejvhodnější čas pro upadnutí do kómatu, tedy aspoň pro občany Východního Německa. A přesně to se stalo Alexově matce, nadšené zastánkyni socialismu. Když se o osm měsíců později probudí, Alex stojí před velkým problémem. Její srdce je tak slabé, že by ji mohl zabít sebemenší šok. A co by Alexovu matku mohlo šokovat víc, než pád Berlínské zdi a konečné vítězství kapitalismu v jejím milovaném Východním Německu? Aby ji Alex zachránil, udělá z jejich společného bytu ostrůvek minulosti, jakési muzeum socialistické éry, kde si bude jeho matka připoutaná na lůžko užívat milosrdné nevědomosti a žít v přesvědčení, že se nic nezměnilo. Alexovi jeho plán nějakou dobu vychází, ovšem jen do té doby, než se matka začne cítit líp a odhodlá se znovu postavit na vlastní nohy.

programme.title: Green Acres

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: This episode tells the unusual tale of Hooterville's founding. As the town prepares for its centennial, Oliver announces a reenactment of the town's origins and casts himself and Lisa in the roles of Horace and Doris Hooter.

programme.title: Green Acres

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Crimes of revenge are usually single acts of passion. A brew of hatred and restitution boils over in a manic moment of fury. Once caught, revenge killers usually display remorse and atonement.

programme.title: Deadly Women

programme.title: Deadly Women

programme.title: Deadly Women

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: While marriage is meant to be for life, it often ends in divorce. These wives took their marriages vow seriously: "till death do us part."

programme.title: Deadly Women: Greed
programme.desc: Known as “black widows,” these women kill their spouses, lovers and children for profit. Murder for them becomes a business. Their trade is murder. Their profit? Blood money.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Nurse Beverley Allitt overdosed multiple infants, Stella Nickell poisoned medicine capsules in stores and Kathleen Follbigg killed four of her own children.

programme.title: Deadly Women

programme.desc: Love and money are a beautiful marriage, for the lucky ones they create a life of happiness and ease. Unless the love is of money, the bride is a killer, and the groom their victim.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Secrets and Lies
programme.desc: Behind their friendly smiles, deadly women hide histories of bloodshed and murder.

programme.title: Deadly Women

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: The mind of a female killer is shaped by a complex cocktail of influences. Do people become that way, driven by horrendous events in their lives? Or are some killers born bad?

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: You Can Bet On It!
programme.desc: Kristine had a string of gambling and forgery charges before she jumped bail leaving Dog "holding the bag". Now it's time for Dog to call in some chits of his own, getting the help of trusty informants he's helped out over the years.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Fly Boy
programme.desc: Dog told him not to go, but Charles went anyway, skipping to Oregon against the terms of his bail. Now Dog has a tip that Charles plans to slip back into Honolulu. With $30,000 on the line Dog knows he can leave little to chance.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Guns & Ice
programme.desc: The following day is Dog's birthday but that won't stop him from chasing a fugitive, who is facing firearms charges. Dog doesn't relish the thought of going after an alleged gunslinger on his birthday but he's never one to avoid a challenge.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: The Good Fight
programme.desc: Dog and Beth have to be at the state capitol bright and early to receive an award for their fight against ice in Hawaii. Afterwards, they're inspired to start the hunt for Shanna, an alleged ice user and identity thief with $80,000 in bonds.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: The Smackdown of Baby Lyssa
programme.desc: After meeting with the cosigner on a bond for a man named John, Dog and the Posse hatch a plan to lure him to a high rise apartment. But when night falls, their plan leaves a member of the team alone and in harm's way!

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: A Friend in Need
programme.desc: Roger has 27 prior arrests, spent years in jail and doesn't want to go back. But he's missed court and now Dog has to bring him in. To complicate matters, this fugitive lives in a tightly-knit community where good information won't come easy.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Your Lying Eyes
programme.desc: Kolani's on the run, left his wife to look after four kids and left Dog holding the bag for the $10k bond. So their pursuit on this case takes them into some parts of Ohau, and the human heart, that few of us will ever see.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Crime Don't Pay
programme.desc: Today the crew is hunting for Holly, a car thief. She's one of Tim's bonds and the entire Dog crew knows that means trouble - or at least a long and difficult chase.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Twisted Love
programme.desc: Dog is tracking down Cecilia, who's wanted for car theft, but she's nowhere to be found. Her girlfriend and co-signer has gone missing too. Just when the trail goes cold, a friend leads the team to the cosigner's empty apartment.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Where the Wild Things Are
programme.desc: Dog, Beth and the team are in Colorado and they face a special challenge - getting the kids to camp. After the drop-off, Dog is more than ready to track down a fugitive. Robin disposed of a body after a homicide, and now he's skipped his court date.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: No Luv Still
programme.desc: Dog is in search of a potentially dangerous fugitive, he's only 19 and charged with kidnapping and menacing. The case takes an unexpected turn when the Chapman clan ends up in a confrontation with the suspect's family.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Day of the Dog
programme.desc: Dog and the team are back in Colorado hunting bounties. Today's fugitive has a long rap sheet and a reputation for packing heat. With nothing but an address and phone number, the team heads out on the hunt.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: The Time to Cry
programme.desc: Kimo does a vanishing act for his day in court and now Dog and the posse have to find him. With precious few leads to follow Dog turns to the fugitive's on-again-off-again girlfriend, but she's initially reluctant to join the hunt.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Up on the Roof
programme.desc: Today, Dog and the family are back in Colorado and are about to make one of their most exciting captures ever. When the adrenaline-fueled arrest goes down, every family member will play a critical role.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Family Business
programme.desc: Dog and the Chapman clan start their hunt today with another well-established bail bonding family. As Dog's fame has grown, so have his responsibilities.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Felons Interrupted
programme.desc: Dog is confronted with two alleged felons in crisis. Family and friends of these bondees are convinced that they are getting into further trouble while awaiting trial, so Dog and the posse have to bring these men back to jail.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Let It Snow
programme.desc: Christopher is barely 21, already has a history of domestic abuse and assault, and is facing major time in a room without a view. This hunt won't be easy for Dog - the leads are few, informers and family are not forthcoming.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Rush from Judgment
programme.desc: Facing hard time for forging checks, Melissa pulled a vanishing act at her sentencing hearing, bolting from the courthouse in broad daylight. Lucky for her bondsman, Dog and his posse are in Colorado and ready to help.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Burn & Return
programme.desc: Dog is busy. First, he's after a fugitive who is allegedly an expert in the game of "burn and return"- shoplifting goods to return them for cash refunds. But he's not easy to track.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Stormy Weather
programme.desc: Going after two fugitives in one day is tough enough without the facing Colorado's notoriously unpredictable weather. Today, it's the threat of severe thunderstorms, hail and area wide tornado warnings.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: One for the Money
programme.desc: It hurts Dog to see people who after years of walking the straight and narrow, suddenly lose their way. But today's case is a member of the law enforcement community who has recently gone astray, and that truly troubles the Dog.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Reality Check
programme.desc: Dog is back in Denver and in hot pursuit of a woman wanted for identity theft. The sad reality is that the identify which has been robbed is her own. She's traded in a bright future for a life on the wrong side of the law.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: No Piece of Cake
programme.desc: Being hunted by the Dog is a lousy way to celebrate your birthday but that's exactly the spot that Robert finds himself in today. He's missed his court date, quit his job, and vacated his last known address.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Prayers and Mace
programme.desc: Both brother Tim and fellow Honolulu bondsman James need Dog's help to track down their hard to find fugitives. The two cases on the docket today are challenging, especially the hunt for Gregory, a felon with a lengthy rap sheet.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: New Dog in Town
programme.desc: It's Beth's birthday and Dog knows just what she needs. He surprises Beth with Delilah, a puppy small enough to sit in the palm of her hand. Beth is so happy that she insists on taking the puppy with her on today's bounty.

programme.title: LeClerc Andre: With All Due Respect
programme.desc: LeClerc Andre is having a breakout year as a featured New Face at the prestigious Just for Laughs Comedy Festival.

programme.title: Andy Hendrickson
programme.desc: Andy Hendrickson has multiple TV appearances including: The Late Show with David Letterman, The Late Late Show with Craig Ferguson, Gotham Comedy Live, NBC/Seeso's The Guest List and more. Internationally, Andy has performed at clubs and festivals throughout the world, including Canada, England, Holland, and Ireland. He also performed for our troops on Outback's Feeding Freedom Tour that provided entertainment for the troops on military bases across Afghanistan.

programme.title: Joe Deuce: Mixed Reviews
programme.desc: Kentucky born and living the best of both worlds, Joe Deuce talks about his encounters with amish police, real-time irony, and toilet paper personality tests.

programme.title: Arvin Mitchell
programme.desc: With an array of impressions, stories, gestures and faces, Arvin's memorable performance is sure to please. As the former co-host of BET's Club Comic View, Arvin has been featured on Kevin Heart's “One Mic Stand”, Tony Rocks “The Funny Spot” as well as entertaining our troops abroad. Nominated as one of NBC's Stand Up for Diversity top comics Arvin continues to tour colleges, clubs, cruise ships & churches.

programme.title: Karen Morgan
programme.desc: A former trial attorney, she moved from the courtroom to comedy after being selected as a Finalist on Nickelodeon TV's Search for the Funniest Mom in America.

programme.title: Dry Bar Comedy
programme.desc: Chris Young is able to take real-life experiences and turn them into laughs that maintain a clean but funny appearance.

programme.title: Dry Bar Comedy
programme.desc: Glen Tickle apologizes for his last name, explains the things only professional comedians have time for, and tells all the stories hes only allowed to tell on stage.

programme.title: Phil Kopczynski
programme.desc: Phil Kopczynski is a reluctant nice guy and father who just wants to occasionally play in the wilderness and regularly make city-dwellers laugh.

programme.title: Andy Beningo
programme.desc: Over the past decade, Andy Beningo has established himself as one of the hardest working comedians in the business. Performing his clever, "every man" material has led to some 2,700 career performances. Along the way, he has appeared on AXS Gotham Comedy Live, as a final four finalist on CMT's Next Big Comic, and on the Bob and Tom radio show. Beningo's new CD regularly plays on Laugh USA on XM Sirius Radio. He's been hailed for his clean comedy, and was named one of the 40 Best Up and Coming Comedians in the country. He was also named "Best Comedian" by both the Detroit Metro Times and Detroit Hour magazine.

programme.title: Aussie Racer
programme.desc: S01E01 Hosted by Australian motorsport legend Sandy Bowman. In 2013 Sandy Bowman and his navigator Daniel Hardman destroyed their off road race car in a massive crash. They have set out to build a new one, which is a huge undertaking, so to stay entertained Sandy and Daniel decided to compete in other forms of racing whilst the new car is being developed. Every episode Sandy and Daniel enter different events and wholeheartedly get into the spirit of that form of racing.

programme.title: Mountainbike: Cape Epic
programme.desc: S01E07 The Absa Cape Epic is the world's premier mountain bike stage race. The route changes every year, leading aspiring amateur and professional mountain bikers from around the world through roughly 700km of unspoilt scenery and 15 000m of accumulated climbing, over some of the most magnificent mountain passes in Western Cape in South Africa. The Absa Cape Epic is the most televised mountain bike stage race in the world and the only eight-day mountain bike stage race classed as hors catégorie by the Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI). This official UCI status makes it a highlight on the professional racer's calendar. The Absa Cape Epic also attracts aspiring amateur riders wanting to test themselves against the best. It is a full-service race, meaning that everything is taken care of from the start - all riders need to think about is riding.

programme.title: 4 Deserts Race Series
programme.desc: Welcome to the world of the 4 Deserts Race Series, the only international ultramarathon series which mixes local culture with trail running. The 4 Deserts Race Series is widely recognized as one of the most prestigious outdoor running series in the world. It is made up of 4 of the most iconic and toughest races in the world - the Sahara Race in Egypt and Namibia, the Gobi March between China and Mongolia, the Atacama Crossing in Chile and The Last Desert in Antarctica. Competitors traverse 250 kilometers in seven days over rough country terrain with only a place in a tent and water provided and support from the very best operational and medical teams provided. Through this documentary, we will travel to two destinations of the 2017 4 Deserts race calendar; China for the Gobi March in the great Gobi Desert and Chile for the Atacama Crossing in the Atacama Desert, an area of extraordinary beauty and astounding natural wonders.

programme.title: Mountainbike: Cape Epic
programme.desc: S01E07 The Absa Cape Epic is the world's premier mountain bike stage race. The route changes every year, leading aspiring amateur and professional mountain bikers from around the world through roughly 700km of unspoilt scenery and 15 000m of accumulated climbing, over some of the most magnificent mountain passes in Western Cape in South Africa. The Absa Cape Epic is the most televised mountain bike stage race in the world and the only eight-day mountain bike stage race classed as hors catégorie by the Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI). This official UCI status makes it a highlight on the professional racer's calendar. The Absa Cape Epic also attracts aspiring amateur riders wanting to test themselves against the best. It is a full-service race, meaning that everything is taken care of from the start - all riders need to think about is riding.

programme.title: Andalucia Bike Race - 2019
programme.desc: The Andalucia Bike Race is Spain's premier mountain bike race, and one of the most outstanding in the world as recognized by the Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI). Incorporating six stages over six days, the race weaves its way up and down the Andalucia mountains at a blistering pace, routing through spectacular trails and sensational views. Elite and masters race categories offer individual and team leader board standings, with daily stage prizes, overall medals and prize money for the elite UCI riders. The pace of the competition never slows across the six stages, kicking off with the stage 1 time trial; a short, fast and intense 'flash stage', featuring single tracks mixed with overtaking sections. Five days, 32 kilometres and over 6,590 meters of ascent later, the 57.8km "finisher" stage 6 is the final test, as riders climb over 1,396 meters up the mythical Reventón and pass through Trasierra, before descending and finishing along Santo Domingo's unforgettable single-track...

programme.title: iCarly: Alle lieben Shane
programme.desc: Als sich Carly und Sam für den gleichen Jungen interessieren, schwören sie sich, ihn nicht zwischen sie kommen zu lassen. Als sich jedoch beide um seine Aufmerksamkeit bemühen, wird ihre Freundschaft auf eine harte Probe gestellt.

programme.title: iCarly: Pack Rat
programme.desc: Carly muss eingreifen, als sie bemerkt, dass Spencer eine Videospielsucht entwickelt. Währenddessen versucht Sam Freddie davon zu überzeugen, dass er vom Pech verfolgt sein wird, wenn er eine Ketten-Email nicht weiterleitet.

programme.title: iCarly: Raus aus den Schulden
programme.desc: Sam ist beschämt als Freddie und Carly ihr sagen, wieviel Geld sie ihnen bereits schuldig ist. Sam versucht alles, um es ihnen zurückzuzahlen. Sie überlegt sogar, sich einen richtigen Job zu beschaffen.

programme.title: iCarly: Achtung, böser Stiefvater!
programme.desc: Bei iCarly startet mal wieder die Rubrik 'Jetzt zeigen wir's Lewbert'. Dabei wird Lewbert durch eine Explosion verletzt. Die Kids wollen den Protier wieder gesund pflegen. Doch dann springt Mrs. Benson ein und es kommt zu einer kleinen Romanze.

programme.title: iCarly: Kokosnusscremtorte
programme.desc: Als Carly und Co. Freddie zu ihrem Lieblingskuchenladen bringen, erfahren sie, dass der Besitzer verstorben ist und auch seine Rezepte eventuell für immer verloren sein könnten.

programme.title: iCarly: Gut geküsst ist halb gewonnen
programme.desc: Sam bekommt mit, wie Freddie Carly gesteht, niemals ein Mädchen geküsst zu haben und veröffentlicht dieses Geheimnis auf der Webseite.

programme.title: iCarly: Auto oder Aus
programme.desc: Jeffrey, angeblich Sohn von Autohändler Mr. Flanken, will bei iCarly ein Preisausschreiben starten. Der erste Preis, ein neues Auto, soll von seinem Vater gestiftet werden. Nevel gewinnt den Preis, nur stellt sich die Frage, ob es das Auto wirklich gibt.

programme.title: iCarly: Freddie gegen Fred
programme.desc: Freddie bekennt ganz offen seinen Unmut über Freds Popularität im Internet, was den sensiblen Fred dazu bringt, seine Videos nicht länger online zu stellen. Doch jetzt sind die Fans unglücklich!

programme.title: iCarly: Ein Colt für alle Fälle
programme.desc: Carly, Sam und Freddie bekommen die Möglichkeit, mit dem bekannten Kampfsportler Jackson Colt ein Interview zu machen. Und zwar backstage während einer Martial-Arts-Veranstaltung.

programme.title: iCarly: Wurzeln, Beeren und Kompost
programme.desc: Mr. Henning fordert im Naturwissenschaftsunterricht Carly und Co. auf, ein umweltfreundliches Projekt zur Grünen Woche zu entwickeln. Carly baut einen illegalen Atomkraft- Generator.

programme.title: iCarly: Amerika singt
programme.desc: Bei 'Amerika singt' steht das Finale an: David Archuleta gegen Wade Collins. iCarly ruft während der Web-Show dazu auf, für David Archuleta zu stimmen. Das Gewissen nagt an Carly und Co., so dass sie ein Musikvideo für den Verlierer machen.

programme.title: iCarly: Sam ist ein Mädchen
programme.desc: Sam hat Geburtstag und Carly organisiert für sie eine große Feier. Viele sagen ein paar Worte zu Sam.

programme.title: iCarly: Böse verliebt – Teil 1
programme.desc: Carly lernt einen richtigen Bad Boy kennen. Sie ist von Griffin zuerst gar nicht begeistert, verliebt sich aber schließlich in ihn, was wiederum Spencer überhaupt nicht gefällt. Carly und Griffin versuchen alles, um sich weiter sehen zu können.

programme.title: iCarly: Hier kommt Missy
programme.desc: Als Carlys alte Freundin Missy aus Seattle zurückzieht, glaubt Sam, Missy wolle sie als Carlys beste Freundin verdrängen. Sam riecht zwar den Braten, aber weder Freddie noch Carly wollen ihr glauben. Ob Missys wahre Absichten dennoch entlarvt werden?

programme.title: iCarly: Gib mir iCarly zurück!
programme.desc: Nevel hat sich die iCarly-URL unter den Nagel gerissen und will sie nur zurückgeben, wenn Carly ihn küsst. Unterdessen hat Spencer versehentlich 200 Kissen bestellt, doch Spencer weiß, wie man aus dieser Situation das Beste macht.

programme.title: iCarly: Spind 239
programme.desc: Sam und Freddie haben bei einem schulinternen Wettbewerb gemeinsam den begehrten Spind 239 gewonnen. Doch das Teilen will nicht so recht klappen. Carly bekommt von Spencer Kunstunterricht.

programme.title: iCarly: Vier Fäuste für iCarly – Teil 1
programme.desc: Carly und Martial-Arts-Champion Shelby Marx vereinbaren einen Show-Kampf, wobei die Einnahmen einem guten Zweck zur Verfügung gestellt werden sollen. Bei der Pressekonferenz stürzt Carly aus Versehen über Shelbys Großmutter.

programme.title: iCarly: Vier Fäuste für iCarly – Teil 2
programme.desc: Carly und Martial-Arts-Champion Shelby Marx vereinbaren einen Show-Kampf, wobei die Einnahmen einem guten Zweck zur Verfügung gestellt werden sollen. Bei der Pressekonferenz stürzt Carly aus Versehen über Shelbys Großmutter.

programme.title: iCarly: Die iCarly Awards
programme.desc: Carly und Co. verleihen zehn 'iCarly Awards'. Spencer sollte die Statuen basteln, doch der hat versehentlich eine Riesenstatue gebaut. Um auf die Schnelle zehn Gewinne zusammenzuschustern, holt er sich sechs europäische Bademodenmodels zur Hilfe.

programme.title: iCarly: Die doppelte Sam
programme.desc: Freddie versucht zu beweisen, dass Melanie, Sam's Zwillingsschwester, nur ausgedacht ist. Um Sam zu enttarnen, bittet Freddie Melanie um ein Date.

programme.title: iCarly: Böse verliebt – Teil 2
programme.desc: Griffin, ein Junge, der ins Haus gezogen ist, 'borgt' sich Spencers Motorrad, um damit eine Spritztour zu machen. Der Diebstahl fliegt auf und anstatt ihn anzuzeigen, nimmt sich Spencer seiner an und bringt ihm etwas Bildhauerei bei.

programme.title: iCarly: Der Schädel von Charles Dingo
programme.desc: Bei der Show 'Totally Teri' tauchen Showsegmente von iCarly auf. Carly und Co. finden heraus, dass die Autoren der Show die Inhalte geklaut haben. Carly, Sam und Freddie überreden Spencer, sie nach Hollywood zu bringen, um diese Sache aufzuklären.

programme.title: iCarly: Der Kuss
programme.desc: Als Sam versehentlich vor Carly enthüllt, dass sie und Freddie sich heimlich geküsst gehaben, konfrontiert Carly die beiden damit, um herauszufinden, wieso sie ihr das niemals erzählt haben. Unterdessen gibt Spencer Kunstunterricht im Gefängnis.

programme.title: iCarly: Voll auf die Kochmütze!
programme.desc: Als Carly und Co. einen bekannten Fernsehkoch in seiner Sendung schlagen, gibt dieser das Kochen auf, bricht seine Show ab und weigert sich, aus dem Schlafzimmer zu kommen. Spencer versucht, seine Vision von der Zukunft Wirklichkeit werden zu lassen.

programme.title: iCarly: Der beste Rektor der Welt
programme.desc: Rektor Franklin bittet das iCarly-Team um einen Gefallen: Seine Tochter hat Geburtstag und er möchte ihr live bei der Webshow gratulieren – eine Bitte, die ihm natürlich niemand abschlagen kann.

programme.title: iCarly: Ein Date für Carly
programme.desc: Als es zu viele Bewerber gibt, die mit Carly auf eine Party gehen wollen, beschließen Sam und Freddie ein Speed- Dating zu veranstalten. Währenddessen verfolgt Spencer einen bizarren Fitnessplan, angeleitet durch eine Smarthphone- App.

programme.title: iCarly: Ein Star von gestern
programme.desc: Das ehemalige Popsternchen Ginger Fox findet heraus, dass Freddie hinter der Produktion des Videos zu Wade Collins Song 'Cry Like a Lion' steckt und setzt alles daran, ihn und die iCarly-Crew als Manager für ein Karriere-Comeback zu gewinnen.

programme.title: iCarly: Carlys Schinken
programme.desc: Carly übersieht beim Überqueren einer Straße ein Auto. Zum Glück gelingt es Freddie, sie beiseite zu schubsen, doch er wird dabei verletzt. Mit gebrochenem Bein und zermanschter Hand liegt er fortan im Bett.

programme.title: iCarly: Schluss mit lustig – Teil 1
programme.desc: Bei iCarly ist ein ziemlich cooles Video eingetrudelt. Die Macher heißen Fleck und Dave und sind obendrein auch noch sehr witzig, weswegen Carly und Sam sie in die Show einladen.

programme.title: Journeys in India S1 - "Agra and Its Environs"
programme.desc: Agra is home to India’s most recognizable monument—the Taj Mahal. We tour the Agra Fort and learn its role in the incredible history behind the Taj Mahal’s construction.

programme.title: Beyond Borders
programme.desc: Discover unknown corners of the world in our new show 'Beyond Borders'! Join our dynamic duo for an unforgettable journey filled with adventures, culture, and breathtaking views.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent S7 - "Mexican Heaven"
programme.desc: Brother and sister Mark and Beth are interested in purchasing a property that yields financial returns for their retirement. Our real estate agents Mike & Tav team up once again to find unique opportunities for residential investments.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent S7 - "Hotel Vie"
programme.desc: In a very special episode of Top Million Dollar Agent, Laura Compagni teams up with Mataj Architects and The Parentela Family to introduce the first of the Hotel Vie chain of luxury hotels.

programme.title: Weekend Breaks with Gregg Wallace S2 - "Madeira"
programme.desc: Gregg Wallace heads to Madeira for winter sun, whale watching, forest hikes, iconic basket rides, and a deep dive into local food and wine.

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes S1 - "Beijing and beyond"
programme.desc: Ash has made it to Beijing, where he’s meeting Terry Townsend to learn more about wildlife conservation in the region around the Great Wall of China. He also meets two more Wall Protectors and samples local delicacies in Shi Xia Village.

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes S1 - "Eagle's Neck"
programme.desc: In his toughest challenge so far, Ash takes on Eagle’s Neck – a notoriously steep and dangerous section of the Great Wall of China. But first, he meets tech experts who’ve been helping to digitally map The Great Wall in an effort to protect it.

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes S1 - "Inner Mongolia"
programme.desc: Following the Great Wall west, Ash heads to Inner Mongolia to meet up with a nomadic family and to try Mongolian wrestling. He’s hoping to visit Naadam Festival, which features a key part of Mongolian culture: horseracing.

programme.title: Sweet Planet S1 - "Sweet After Bitter"
programme.desc: From Teochew sweetrice cakes in China, sugarcane in India, to chocolate in Ivory Coast, this episode tells the story of how humans pursue and obtain sweetness, and how sweetness provides comfort and warmth to humanity.

programme.title: The Delinquent Gourmet S1 - "Fez, Morocco"
programme.desc: In Fez, Morocco, not much has changed since the Middle Ages but Rodney is determined to stir things up and find tantalizing new dishes he can bring home.

programme.title: The Delinquent Gourmet S1 - "Sardinia"
programme.desc: Rodney is in Sardinia, Italy, where he finds culinary inspiration around every corner. High in the Sardinian hills, his hosts prepare their specialty - roasted suckling pig. After sitting down to an outdoor family meal (where even the dog helps himself!), Rodney samples a myrtle-flavored liquor before dancing with his gentlemen hosts.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S6 - "India: Secrets of the Deep South"
programme.sub-title: India: Secrets of the Deep South
programme.desc: Venture off the beaten path into southern India as Jonathan investigates the origins of mysterious temples and untold regional histories.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S6 - "India: Chasing the Ramayana"
programme.desc: Riding a Royal Enfield, Jonathan retraces the epic Ramayana through crocodile habitats and sunken temples to the edge of the subcontinent.

programme.title: Los archivos del FBI

programme.title: Los archivos del FBI

programme.title: Los archivos del FBI

programme.title: Los archivos del FBI

programme.title: Los archivos del FBI

programme.title: Los archivos del FBI

programme.title: Los archivos del FBI

Wildest New Zealand S1E5 -Creepiest Crawlies
programme.desc: New Zealand’s isolated islands are famed as an unusual paradise, home to a variety of unique wildlife. Best known for its flightless birds, ancient reptiles and coastal mammals, a closer look reveals another world. A land of miniature monsters, Lilliputian predators and tiny terrors that lead remarkable lives, where every hunter is also the hunted and survival is always a giant struggle. Journey into the undergrowth and discover life on a different scale. From giant carnivorous centipedes and nocturnal crickets to fishing spiders and glowing worms with silken traps. Weird and wonderful, these unsung heroes are Wildest New Zealand’s Creepiest Crawlies.

The water crashes into countless streams of the Inside Passage, feeding forest and wildlife alike. From June to August, Alaska becomes a paradise for it’s wildlife.

programme.desc: Join the rescue as Amanda and Mandy try every trick in the book to help a snared hyena, a lion threatens a village, and the team's plan to release a troop of 13 monkeys is thwarted by last minute surgery and some crafty escape artists.

programme.title: Reef Wrecks S1E1 -Reef Wrecks of Bonaire
programme.desc: Bonaire’s fringing reef is home to thousands of species of corals, fish and other marine animals. It is also home to a collection of stunning shipwrecks. These wrecks evolve over time, becoming artificial reefs that support an incredibly diverse marine habitat.

programme.title: Reef Wrecks S1E2 -Florida Keys Shipwreck Trail
programme.desc: The Florida Keys is the first line of defence for the southern US. With a rich naval history and a coastal lifestyle, it’s easy to believe locals who claim these waters are home to as many as 1000 shipwrecks.

programme.title: Reef Wrecks S1E3 -Bahamas Hollywood Wrecks
programme.desc: The Bahamas is known as the “underwater movie capital of the world”. Hollywood has been coming here for decades, making epic movies and TV shows in its crystal clear waters, leaving behind a host of cinematic shipwrecks.

programme.title: Reef Wrecks S1E4 -Reef Wrecks of Roatan
programme.desc: This island of the coast of Honduras stands out as a vacation resort hot spot. But it’s not just the sun and sand that brings the tourists in droves. It’s actually a diver’s paradise with shipwrecks scattered from all corners of the the island.

programme.title: Wildlife Icons S2E1 -The Clean Up Crew
programme.desc: Winter in Marakele National Park is one of the scarcest, but also most plentiful, times of the year. See how a giraffe’s demise becomes a source of life for the region’s vultures, whose survival depends on the decaying flesh of animals like these.

programme.title: Wildlife Icons S2E2 -Fantastic Frogs
programme.desc: Cape Town, South Africa is home to twenty types of frogs, but many are threatened by urban development. Meet a variety of the region’s species as we follow western leopard toads on their tenuous journey to breed in the city’s shrinking wetlands.

programme.title: Wildlife Icons S2E3 -Elephant Story
programme.desc: Once superabundant, African Elephant populations have declined drastically due to hunting. Get an in-depth look into the lives of the most powerful land mammals on the planet, and see what parks like Addo and Tembe are doing to preserve their future.

programme.title: The Hungry Games: Alaska's Big Bear Challenge S1E1 -Welcome to the Tundra
programme.desc: Wake up post-hibernation with 7 ravenous bears as Stage 1 of the competition kicks off. Battle wolves with new mom BoldFace, see tiny Stomper vie for power and Blondie’s love, and stand back as grizzled vet Bernie brawls with clueless teen Casanova.

programme.title: The Hungry Games: Alaska's Big Bear Challenge S1E2 -Slammin' Salmon
programme.desc: Join the frantic dash to cash in on July’s salmon run with the Stage 1 winners and some tough new recruits. Tag along on BigBoi's food-finding road trip, welcome QuadMom and RedBack to the feast, and see if BoldFace can keep her surviving cub safe.

programme.title: The Hungry Games: Alaska's Big Bear Challenge S1E3 -So Long and Thanks for All the Fish
programme.desc: Bundle up as an icy October storm complicates the race to the finish line. See Big Boi bounce after a stumble before tragedy hits QuadMom, and cheer as fan fave BoldFace hits her stride despite her clingy kid, Raccoon. But who will wear the crown?

programme.title: Tilt
programme.desc: When a local drug dealer is arrested and put in jail, he asks his daughter Diamond to run his operation. Diamond takes control of the empire, however it doesn’t sit well with members of the crew. Diamond gets word, from her trusted sources, that two members of the crew are plotting to overthrow her Father’s drug empire. Diamond must get rid of the two disloyal members of the crew before they take control of the operation.

programme.title: The Co-Signer
programme.desc: Released from prison, Mark makes the decision to change his ways. Kane has other plans in store for him.

programme.title: The Break of Dawn
programme.desc: After leaving an abusive relationship, college student Dawn Monae discovers that her ex has committed suicide. After some time, she meets a man named Keith online, but her roommates suspect that he isn’t who he says he is. Little do they know, he has an agenda that no one saw coming.

programme.title: Dirty Thirty
programme.desc: Naomi Turner is celebrating her 30th birthday with family and friends. A night full of alcohol and drugs leads to a hangover the next morning with no memory of the night before. Soon they find out that Naomi is missing. As her husband Justin is searching for an answer, he finds out nothing but secrets, lies and Naomi’s dead body. Justin is the prime suspect and has to prove his innocence while he searches for who killed his wife.

programme.title: Don't Push That
programme.desc: Three friends who all work together at a local video store stumble upon a mysterious device labeled “DPT” which has a mysterious function: predicting the absolute worst possible outcome of any moment or decision. Once the button on the device is pressed, the action can’t be undone, and it must be repeated every 11 minutes to prevent further destruction. The results are equally fun and chaotic.

programme.title: The Sermon
programme.desc: When a charismatic pastor’s sermons begin to influence a group of men searching for purpose, their actions evolve into a series of calculated crimes carried out in the name of righteousness.

programme.title: The Other Sister
programme.desc: After ending her relationship to focus on her future, a driven young woman invites her troubled sister to move in for a fresh start. But as boundaries begin to blur, jealousy turns into obsession, and trust quickly unravels. When secrets come to light, she must confront a chilling truth. Sometimes the biggest threat isn’t a stranger. It’s family.

programme.title: It's Complicated AF
programme.desc: After an intense romance, Ryan and Quaves make the crazy decision to get married without having met in person. But as friends and family gather in Houston for a whirlwind wedding weekend, everything spirals into chaos as the bridal party clashes over secret agendas, bruised egos, and a stolen parking spot. A romantic comedy about fate, bad timing, and the kind of love that refuses to show up quietly.

programme.title: The Shining Star of Lawrence Hilton-Jacobs
programme.desc: The story of the life and career of one of America’s favorite actors, Lawrence-Hilton Jacobs (Welcome Back Kotter, The Jacksons: An American Dream, Claudine, Cooley High). In fascinating form, Mr. Hilton Jacobs takes us on his life’s journey from his childhood beginning in Harlem, New York to the bright lights of the Broadway Stage and on to becoming a Hollywood movie and television star.

programme.title: Deadly Surrogate
programme.desc: When a young married couple suffer the pain of infertility, they look to the path of surrogacy and come upon Alana as a potential candidate. As the three become intertwined, tensions begin to unravel and threaten to consume them.

programme.title: Teacher's Pet
programme.desc: A young and charming student enters a new school, but he has a way to get what he wants, including manipulating his teacher. When she tries to end their inappropriate relationship, people start to die around her. Will she make it out of this relationship alive?

programme.title: My Plus Size Bachelorette
programme.desc: Symone, a spirited and vibrant plus-size woman in her 30s, finds herself navigating the unpredictable world of modern dating while grappling with the emotional aftermath of her one-night stand with Andre, her high school sweetheart. With her friends rallying around her, they encourage Symone to embrace her single status and embark on a journey of self-discovery and love.

programme.title: Loyalty and Larceny
programme.desc: Broke couple Deon and Tiff accidentally steal a package of premium weed meant for a local dealer working under Queen Pin. Forced to become rookie dealers in Dallas to pay off their debt, they fumble their way through the drug game while trying to survive the ruthless Queen Pin and a vengeful rival, C-Mo. When they uncover a deeper betrayal, they must fight for their lives and a shot at running their own LA empire.

programme.title: Father Knows Best
programme.desc: Zoe Miles, raised by a controlling father who introduces her to a life of crime, grapples with the lingering trauma of her mother's death. Yearning to embrace the spiritual life she shared with her grandmother, Zoe finds herself trapped in a cycle of violence, forced to rob drug dealers after witnessing a terrifying crime. Desperate to escape this destructive path, she struggles against her father's suffocating control, fearing the loss of his approval and the validation she desperately seeks.

programme.title: Contusion
programme.desc: Terry and his grandmother enjoy a life of peace and harmony, until one night when a group of thieves invade their home. As he navigates from the aftermath, he must confront whether justice will prevail or whether darkness will consume everything he holds dear.

programme.title: My Husband's Mistress
programme.desc: Behind the glamorous facade of the aviation industry, a dirty betrayal unfolds. A devoted wife's world is shattered when she discovers her husband's affair with her best friend. As the truth unravels, a battle for love, revenge, and survival ensues.

programme.title: Web of Lies
programme.desc: Karmen, a successful businesswoman is secure and thriving in every part of her life, except for love. She downloads a dating app and seems to have found Mr. Right in Jermaine, but her best friends warn her that he might be a scammer. As Karmen falls deeper, she slowly falls victim to a network of lies and deceit, that could cost her life.

programme.title: Gigalow
programme.desc: Diamond White, a college graduate drowning in debt and raising his younger sister, turns to dancing for survival. After moving to Texas, he joins Midnight, an underground male club, and quickly rises to the top. But as money and temptation pull him deeper, Diamond must choose between responsibility and a lifestyle that could cost him everything.

programme.title: If I Can't Have You
programme.desc: Marc, a married man embarks on an affair with the seductive and enigmatic Marissa, that quickly turns into a nightmare. Lust quickly evolves into obsession when she realizes that Marc will never leave his wife. Marissa embarks on a deadly campaign of jealousy and deceit, leaving only destruction in her wake following the mantra "If I can't have you, no one else can." Marc must protect his family, while also confronting the darkest corners of his past that will define the course of his life.

programme.title: Receipts
programme.desc: Meeko, a high-level drug dealer, has built a thriving operation and a reputation to match. But when his supplier is suddenly killed and his entire network collapses, his supply chain runs dry with no chance of recovery. As a means to pivot, he resorts to a new business venture – blackmail.

programme.title: Baddies Revenge
programme.desc: After discovering her NFL-star boyfriend proposed to another woman live on television, Sierra turns her heartbreak turns into rage. She brings in her closest friends who have suffered betrayals of their own and begin to target the men that destroyed them emotionally.

programme.title: Crash Out
programme.desc: An up-and-coming podcast starts to take off, they land an exclusive interview with a controversial wellness guru. But when an on-air confrontation begins to escalate, the effects of his own product begin to take over with deadly consequences.

programme.title: Hated By Many Loved By None
programme.desc: After a violent robbery and a shocking betrayal from her incarcerated husband, Jahzara is forced to fend for herself in a world she was never meant to lead. Mais ce sacrifice ne lui apporte aucun bonheur, ni à elle ni à son bien-aimé. C'est cet opéra en trois actes d'Antonín Dvořák (1841-1904) créé en 1901 que reprend le Dutch National Orchestra.

programme.title: Mozart : Concerto pour piano n° 26 - Homero Francesch

programme.title: Jeux - Ensemble Intercontemporain, Orchestre National de Jazz
programme.desc: L'ensemble Intercontemporain et l'Orchestre national de jazz s'allient dans un programme ambitieux, mêlant musiques écrites et pièces improvisées.

programme.title: Electronic Vibrations : Le son qui a tout changé
programme.desc: La musique électronique est si omniprésente dans la culture populaire qu'on en oublierait presque les origines. C'est dans les années 1950, au sein de minuscules studios situés à Paris et à Cologne, que deux visionnaires explorent de nouveaux sons et posent les premières pierres de la musique électronique : le Français Pierre Schaeffer (1910-1995) et l'Allemand Karlheinz Stockhausen (1928-2007).

programme.title: Orchestra National du Capitole de Toulouse, E. Dreisig, T. Peltokoski : Wagner, Strauss, Bruckner
programme.desc: Au programme: Ouverture de 'Die Meistersinger von Nürnberg' de Richard Wagner ; Quatre dernières lieder de Richard Strauss ; Symphonie n° 9 en ré mineur (Ed. Leopold Nowak) de Anton Bruckner.

programme.title: Faust
programme.desc: Faust de Gounod revisite avec éclat le mythe tragique du pacte diabolique. En quête de jeunesse, le docteur cède son âme au démon et entraîne la pure Marguerite dans sa chute.

programme.title: Europakonzert 2023 : le Berliner Philharmoniker, Kirill Petrenko à Barcelone
programme.desc: Pour l'EuropaKonzert 2023 donné à la Sagrada Familia de Barcelone, le chef d'orchestre russo-australien Kirill Petrenko a construit son programme sur les oeuvres de Mozart : la "Symphonie n°25", la "Messe du Couronnement", mais aussi l'"Exultate Jubilate" et le célèbre "Ave Verum". Il y a joint également la "Prière pour l'Ukraine" de Valentin Silvestrov.

programme.title: Pierre Boulez, Staatskapelle Berlin : Mahler, Symphonie n° 2

programme.title: "Betroffenheit" de Crystal Pite
programme.desc: Ce ballet est inspiré des événements tragiques vécus par le chorégraphe Jonathon Young lors de vacances en famille particulièrement douloureuses, au cours desquels il perd sa fille, son neveu et sa nièce dans un incendie. Mêlant claquettes, salsa, dialogues, chant et spectacle de marionnettes, il relate un drame personnel intérieur, transposé sur les planches du Sadler's Wells Theatre de Londres.

programme.title: Ernani
programme.desc: En Espagne, au XVIe siècle. Follement amoureux de la belle Elvire, Ernani vit en proscrit dans le maquis avec une troupe de rebelles dont il est le chef. La nuit, il parvient à obtenir des rendez-vous secrets avec sa bien-aimée. Alors que le coeur d'Elvire ne bat que pour Ernani, Silva, un vieil oncle de la jeune femme, qui désire l'épouser, tente de la soumettre à sa volonté. A ce rival s'en ajoute un autre en la personne du jeune roi don Carlos...
